# Sino Trade Link (sinotradelink.com)

> Comprehensive B2B Directory and Offline Sourcing Intelligence Platform for China's Physical Wholesale Markets.

## Overview
Sino Trade Link provides verified access to 27,337+ physical factory stalls and wholesale distributors operating inside Yiwu International Trade City (Futian Market Districts 1–5), Huangyuan Garment Market, and the International Production Materials Market in Zhejiang, China.

All entries contain unmasked direct Chinese telephone lines, WeChat IDs, exact booth coordinates (District, Floor, Gate, Booth number), verified direct factory statuses, and real product catalog samples.

## Core Navigation & Directories
- Directory: https://sinotradelink.com/directory
- Market Floor Map: https://sinotradelink.com/market-map
- Concierge & On-Demand Stall Audit ($99): https://sinotradelink.com/concierge
- Category Wholesaler Excel Packs: https://sinotradelink.com/category-packs
- Supplier API: https://sinotradelink.com/api/suppliers.json

## District Structure
- District 1: Toys, Plush, Artificial Flowers, Jewelry & Ornaments, Porcelain, Crafts (Booths: 1st-4th Floors)
- District 2: Hardware Tools, Locks, Electrical Products, Kitchenware, Household Appliances, Clocks & Watches, Luggage & Bags
- District 3: Office & School Supplies, Stationery, Eyewear & Sunglasses, Sporting Goods, Zippers & Garment Accessories
- District 4: Hosiery & Socks, Daily Necessities, Gloves & Hats, Footwear & Shoes, Belts & Scarves
- District 5: Home Textiles, Bedding, Imported Goods, Curtains, Auto Parts & Accessories
- District 6 (Huangyuan Market): Men's and Women's Apparel, Denim, Children's Clothing, Outerwear
- District 7 (Production Materials Market): Raw materials, injection molding supplies, packaging, commercial printing
